alex: Quick heads up 1:15 UTC we're scheduling a short maintenance in us-west1 to address intermittent NIC packet drops on rack-s3. Observed: bursty egress queue spikes + ~1.1% tail error bump. Plan is a small, staged drain + targeted NIC soft-restarts. Expect minor throughput wobble for ~30-40m. @oncall pls ack. :satellite:
jordan: Acked. I'll coordinate traffic shifts and keep an eye on the cross-region failover ratios. Suggest canary 2 nodes then expand if stable.
alex: Agreed. Canary nodes: rack-s3-node05, rack-s3-node12. Procedure: cordon -> drain -> soft-restart NIC drivers -> warm-kv seed -> resume.
rita: Ops snippet (will paste to runbook):
```
# canary drain
kubectl cordon node/rack-s3-node05
kubectl drain node/rack-s3-node05 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=90
# nic soft-restart (BMC)
ssh bmc-rack-s3-node05 'ipmitool raw 0x30 0x2a 0x01'
# warm kv seed
redis-cli -h kv-usw1 --eval seed_kv.lua 20000
```
dave: I'll queue a temporary routing tweak: reduce max-parallel for rack-s3 to 6 and lower egress cap to 80mbps while we validate. Also will bump p95 alert to 220ms to avoid alert storms.
infra-bot: [maintenance-scheduled] id=mn-usw1-2024-1711112222 window=21:15-22:00 UTC owner=alex.
jordan: Cost note: if we need to spin temporary on-demand for backfill, estimate ~= $900 for the window. Finance pinged.
alex: Customer comm: keep short. Jordan can you draft? "We will perform a brief maintenance in US-West starting 21:15 UTC to improve network stability. Some requests may see slightly higher latency for a short period"
jordan: Yup will post to #customer-notice-drafts at 21:00.
rita: Rollback plan: if error rate > 0.8% or p95 > 250ms for >5m, undo by reintroducing canary nodes and disabling nic soft-restart loop; assign rollback to @dave.
dave: I'll take rollback. Preference: pause expansion, restore nodes, disable route tweak.
alex: Monitoring checklist: watch egress_queue_depth, net-drop-rate, p50/p95 latency, error-rate, kv-miss-rate. Will attach dashboards during run.
jordan: Also run a smoke after each canary step: `curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $SMOKE\" https://api.us-west1.redwood.ai/healthz` expect 200 within 150ms.
rita: FYI found a recurring kernel log line on node05: "mlx5_core: CQ error" timestamped at spikes. This supports NIC soft-restart approach.
infra-bot: [runbook] pinned: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/nic-spike-response
alex: Timeline: 21:00 internal notice -> 21:15 start canary -> 21:30 expand if OK -> 21:55 wind down -> 22:00 post summary. We'll post short perf charts and cost note.
jordan: Oncall SRE notified. I'll be online at start. :eyes:
dave: Ready to execute rollback if needed.
alex: Thanks team. I'll kick at 21:15 and post live updates here. :rocket:
